dataset.description: We-R uses political discourse analysis with the aim of measuring the level of ethnic intolerance in the political space of Western Balkans. The purpose of this dataset is to provide the empirical foundation for testing the research questions and hypothesis.
dataset.title: Political discourse analysis - measuring the level of ethnic intolerance in political speeches in the Western Balkans

dataset.description: We-R uses multimodal discourse analysis with the aim of measuring the impact of constitutional politics of memory on Western Balkans societies by measuring the level of hate speech on social media. The purpose of the dataset is to collect data from social media to understand and address the research hypothesis and questions effectively.
dataset.title: Social Media Research - measuring the level of hate speech in Western Balkans societies

dmp.description: We-R uses a multi-method approach which combines comparative law methodology with empirical research, namely political discourse analysis and multimodal discourse analysis. While the first will be used for examining publicly available political discourses, the second will be used for conducting social media research. The aim of the empirical research is to evaluate the impact of constitutional politics of memory on politics and society in the Western Balkan, .i.e. measure the level of ethnic intolerance in the political sphere and the level of hate speech within society. The purpose of this DMA is to outline how the research data will be collected, organized, stored, documented, and shared throughout the research project.
dmp.title: We-R Data Management Plan
